sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1 for collector rings brushes and 
brush - holders for generator which must be performed on daily - weekly - 
monthly and after shut down as indicated in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Saad El-Nashar, tested by eng. Reda 
Ragab Karam, accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam , approved by eng. 
Gaber Mohamed Farahat and
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia: WDEPC inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.

Safety 
Precautions

items:
A work permit must be 
 issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category

Maintenance staff 
 should be well trained qualified or directly supervised by some one who is

Safety fence with caution 
 marks surrounding the work area is required

Personal protective equipment 
 must be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses)

sections.text:
Tools and 
Equipment

items:
Personal protective equipment as safety 
 shoes, helmet breathing mask and safety glasses
Brushes blower megger
Cleaning fluids such as - chlorothene

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Visual daily checks
The following items should checked
The absence of sparks in the brushes
The normal noise level of the brushes
The state of the flexile leads of the brushes
The state of cleanliness
The temperature of the cooling air (even by simply using a hand or thermometer)

items: The absence of sparks in the brushes
The normal noise level of the brushes
The state of the flexile leads of the brushes
The state of cleanliness
The temperature of the cooling air (even by simply using a hand or thermometer)

sections.text:
Visual inspections and weekly checks
Besides the previous daily checks the following weekly check should be made
Shaft % ground voltage measurement
The state of brush wear
The state of the cooling air filter cleaning

items: Shaft % ground voltage measurement
The state of brush wear
The state of the cooling air filter cleaning

sections.text:
Visual inspections and monthly check
Besides the previous daily and weekly checks the following monthly check should 
be made

The state of the contact surface of the rings with running machine a stroboscope 
lamp synchronized to the rotor speed can be used
Measure and record the vibrations of the brushes (at least per ring)

sections.text: Removal of exciter
Remove the exciter housing including the collector brush rigging
Remove all bolts and dowels holding the exciter base to the foundation
Check to see that all parts all parts are free and that no interference excite

Check the state of the rings and measure their degree wear the depth of any 
grooves and any run 
out : if necessary grind the rings
Check the wear and the state of every brush
Check the freedom of movement of each brush

Check the state of every brush holder and in particular the pressure springs 
substitute any worn out spring
Check the tightness of all the screws in electrical and mechanical connections
Check the cleanliness of the rings and insulating parts
If necessary invert the polarity of the ringsw

sections.text: Gas drier & Hydrogen System
Routine checks

During normal operation the following checks should be made
Hydrogen purity 98 %
Hydrogen pressure 4.15 (according to load)

Every two days check the condition and color of the drier salts - the moisture 
saturated salts turn pink reactive the salts as previously described salts can 
be replaced each year
Check the hydrogen consumption once a week
Check the fullness of hydrogen and carbon dioxide bottles
